name: Peace Lily
description: An elegant indoor plant known for purifying the air. Care & Planting: Plant in well-draining soil. Requires low to medium indirect light and keep the soil lightly moist.

reviews.comment: Beautiful plant, arrived in great condition.

name: Sansevieria
description: An extremely resilient and elegant plant. Care & Planting: Plant in cactus/succulent mix. A great choice for beginners as it requires very little water. Allow soil to dry completely between waterings.

name: Hydrangea
description: A gorgeous outdoor shrub with large, round flower clusters. Care & Planting: Plant in rich, porous soil. Prefers partial shade and regular, deep watering, especially during dry spells.

reviews.comment: Bloomed beautifully in my garden this summer!

name: Red Rose Bouquet
description: A classic bouquet of 11 fresh red roses, the perfect gift for special occasions. Care: Trim stems at a 45-degree angle and change the vase water every two days to maintain freshness.

reviews.comment: My wife loved them, very fragrant.

name: Monstera
description: A tropical beauty with distinctive split leaves. Brings a jungle vibe to any space. Care & Planting: Plant in peat-based potting soil with a moss pole for support. Needs bright indirect light and weekly watering.

reviews.comment: Growing so fast! A new leaf already popped up.
